hash_quoting: 64-hex identities other than the prepared-supply output digests and the study commit are quoted as sha256-prefix16:<first 16 hex>: core.flight.repin rewrites every JSON file of a readiness package from a cell's old identity hashes to its new ones at the flip and refuses any old hash left under docs/, so a full quote would either be rewritten -- falsifying this record of what was computed at study_commit -- or block the flip; the full values are recomputable from study_commit

prepared_supply.note: file_sha256 differs whenever an artifact INPUT differs (the recall width k is an input); output_sha256 is core.preparation.digest over the {facets, values} payload -- the same value ids in the same order on every row -- and is what the flip's byte-identity check and the request composer consume
